svg.title: Thiago Diegoli · Full Stack Developer A Claude Code terminal. Prompts like "fix prod on a friday", "install arch for my grandma", "name this variable" are sent; the spinner cycles through made-up verbs until the usage limit hits, then it all rewinds like a VHS tape and the next prompt is typed
